 EUGENE, Ore. — UPDATE : EPD is reporting that the issue has been resolved. The cause of the outage is being investigated as copper wire theft.
 EPD says that there was a backup system in place, but because it was not local, texting was seen as the more preferable method of contact.
 Original Reporting: 
 The Eugene Police Department (EPD) announced around 7 a.m. on Sunday, Oct. 8, that 911 phone service through Central Lane Communications is currently down, along with the area's non-emergency phone number.
 Anyone experiencing an emergency is instructed to text 911 instead. EPD asks that no one try to "test" the texting system, and to only use it in the event of a real emergency.
 EPD said it will provide an update when phone service is restored.
